name: Hotaka (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Hotaka town emblem in red: a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised letter V, beneath a five-pointed star.
history: Flag of the former town of Hotaka in Nagano Prefecture, dissolved on 2005-10-01.

features.role: Hotaka town emblem — a ring open at the top enclosing a stylised letter V, beneath a five-pointed star
